title: Wrongful or Unfair Dismissal That Will Be Heard by Employment Claims Tribunals
what_it_is: Wrongful or Unfair Dismissal That Will Be Heard by Employment Claims Tribunals

sections.label: Wrongful dismissal claims and tribunals
sections.summary: Two forms of wrongful dismissal claims will be heard by the Employment Claims Tribunals after the EA is amended, with possible reinstatement, compensation or prosecution.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The first form of wrongful dismissal involves dismissal on grounds other than poor performance, misconduct or redundancy.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If the employer dismisses an employee because of his poor performance or misconduct, the employer must be able to substantiate his case.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The second form of wrongful dismissal involves pregnant employees whose contracts have been terminated without their receiving maternity benefits.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Both forms of wrongful dismissal claims will be heard by the Employment Claims Tribunals (ECT), after the EA is amended.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It really depends on the facts of the case.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It depends on whether the employer was able to substantiate the claims and, if he is unable to, the employer may be ordered to reinstate the employee, to provide compensation.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And if the employer does not comply with the order, then he can also be prosecuted.

sections.label: Constructive dismissals and forced resignations
sections.summary: The answer to the question on constructive dismissals or forced resignations is yes.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: One, on constructive dismissals or forced resignations, the answer to the question is yes.

sections.label: FAQs third question
sections.summary: The short answer to the third question on FAQs is yes.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: On the third question on FAQs, the short answer is yes.
